records.system_name_en: Jockey Club of Kenya / Ngong system
records.revalidation_trigger: Revalidate when JCK changes the upcoming-race page or rolls into a new season.
limitations: The reviewed source covers Jockey Club of Kenya meetings at Ngong Racecourse only.
The page lists season meeting dates but not reusable race post times.
Named feature races remain editorial context, not timetable detail.
Source absence or acquisition failure is not cancellation/non-running evidence.
records.notes: GitHub Actions revalidated the live JCK page on 2026-10-09. The 2026-2027 season exposes 18 source-visible meeting dates from September 2026 through July 2027.
